items.markdown: To a solution of 2-bromo-4-hydroxybenzaldehyde (1.00 g, 4.98 mmol) and (bromomethyl)benzene (0.7 mL, 5.97 mmol) in MeCN (10 mL) was added K2CO3 (2.06 g, 14.93 mmol). After addition, then the mixture was stirred at 80 ℃ for 3 hrs. After cooling to 20 ℃, the reaction solution was poured into water (50 mL) and extracted with EtOAc (25 mL × 3). The combined organic layers were washed with brine (25 mL × 2), dried over Na2SO4, filtered and concentrated under reduced pressure to give a residue.
